metadata.notes: Imports winners and finalists from the deterministic secondary table. The official rbctaylorprize.ca domain has lapsed and now redirects to an unrelated site, so the prize archive cannot be re-verified against a primary source and confidence stays secondary. The separate RBC Taylor Emerging Writer Award (for unpublished writers) is excluded.
